run_AVAVisualizerWithPrecomputedBox: run the AVAVisualizerWithPrecomputedBox class to visualize action predictions on a video with precomputed bounding boxes
get_predictions_AVAVisualizerWithPrecomp: get action predictions for each precomputed box in keyframes using the loaded MemVIT model
draw_video_AVAVisualizerWithPrecomputedB: draw predicted and ground-truth bounding boxes on video frames and write the visualized output to a file
merge_pred_gt_boxes: merge precomputed prediction boxes and ground-truth boxes dictionaries into a single combined dictionary
load_boxes_labels: load bounding boxes and labels from AVA format CSV files for a given video name and resolution
